ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will fire whenever an Opportunity is saved, and the Opportunity's probability is equal to or greater than 50% AND the associated Account does not have a complete Billing Street, Billing City, Billing Country, or Phone Number.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator" ), OR( ISBLANK( Account.BillingStreet ), ISBLANK( Account.BillingCity ), ISBLANK( Account.BillingCountry ), ISBLANK( Account.Phone ) ), Probability >= 50 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This validation rule is in place to ensure that all opportunities with a probability of 50% or greater have complete billing information associated with their account. This includes the Billing Street, Billing City, Billing Country, and Phone Number.
